preview.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2026 Forms 1099
preview.body:
Hi,

Attached are the 2026 vendor payments by vendor, the vendor master with each vendor's W-9 status and the accounts payable ledger by account. Please prepare the 2026 Forms 1099-NEC and the transmittal summary for us to review; we file electronically.

The payments file is the final year-end export from accounts payable. A few things to look at:

- Ridgeline Concrete Cutting never sent a W-9. We started backup withholding in April after the third request.
- TIN Matching came back with no match for Cedar Hollow Tile in October. We asked for a new W-9 and have not heard back.
- Tomas Arvelo is still on our list from the Q3 941 review; we have not decided whether he should have been on payroll.
- The September settlement went to the claimant's attorney, and our office rent is paid to the landlord's LLC. I assume those are 1099-MISC, not NEC.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC

findings.title: MISC-01
findings.detail: Two payees belong on Form 1099-MISC, which this run does not prepare: $96,000.00 of office rent to Harbor Ridge Office Holdings LLC (box 1), and the $85,000.00 settlement paid to Moss and Tarrant PLLC (box 10, gross proceeds paid to an attorney). Form 1099-MISC has its own dates: e-filed with the IRS by March 31, 2027.

findings.title: TIN-01
findings.detail: Cedar Hollow Tile (V-109) gave a W-9 with the business name on line 1 and an SSN as a sole proprietor; IRS TIN Matching found no match. Form W-9 asks a sole proprietor for the owner's name on line 1 and the business name on line 2. The draft reports $26,850.00 under the name and TIN on file. A person gets the corrected W-9 before filing; filed as is, the form is likely to draw an IRS notice and a B notice, after which backup withholding would apply.

findings.title: LABOR-01
findings.detail: Tomas Arvelo, an individual, was paid $33,348.00 through accounts payable in 2026 for 794 hours of concrete finishing at $42.00 an hour under the HGC foreman, the question left open by the Q3 Form 941 review. The draft reports a Form 1099-NEC as accounts payable recorded the work. If a person decides the work is employment, the pay belongs on a Form W-2 with withholding instead, and the payroll returns change.

messages.subject: HANGS Construction Services 2026 Forms 1099
messages.body:
Hi,

Attached are the 2026 vendor payments by vendor, the vendor master with each vendor's W-9 status and the accounts payable ledger by account. Please prepare the 2026 Forms 1099-NEC and the transmittal summary for us to review; we file electronically.

The payments file is the final year-end export from accounts payable. A few things to look at:

- Ridgeline Concrete Cutting never sent a W-9. We started backup withholding in April after the third request.
- TIN Matching came back with no match for Cedar Hollow Tile in October. We asked for a new W-9 and have not heard back.
- Tomas Arvelo is still on our list from the Q3 941 review; we have not decided whether he should have been on payroll.
- The September settlement went to the claimant's attorney, and our office rent is paid to the landlord's LLC. I assume those are 1099-MISC, not NEC.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Controller, HANGS Construction Services LLC

passages.q: From when must backup withholding start, and where is it reported?
passages.a: Failure to furnish TIN in the manner required. Withhold on payments made until the TIN is furnished in the manner required. ... Report backup withholding on Form 945, Annual Return of Withheld Federal Income Tax.

passages.q: What is the 2026 threshold for Form 1099-NEC, and did it change?
passages.a: For tax years beginning after 2025, the minimum threshold amount for reporting certain payments required to be reported on certain information returns and/or perform backup withholding on those payments increased to $2,000 and may be adjusted for inflation beginning in calendar year 2027. ... Enter nonemployee compensation (NEC) of $2,000 or more.

passages.q: When are the 2026 Forms 1099-NEC due, and must they be e-filed?
passages.a: Section 6071(c) requires you to file Form 1099-NEC on or before January 31, using either paper or electronic filing procedures. ... If any date shown falls on a Saturday, Sunday, or legal holiday ... the due date is the next business day. ... lowered the e-file threshold to 10 (calculated by aggregating all information returns)

passages.q: Which vendors are left out as corporations, merchandise or card payments?
passages.a: Generally, payments to a corporation (including an LLC) that is treated as a C or S corporation). ... Payments for merchandise, telegrams, telephone, freight, storage, and similar items. ... Payments made with a credit card or payment card ... must be reported on Form 1099-K by the payment settlement entity under section 6050W and are not subject to reporting on Form 1099-MISC or Form 1099-NEC.

sources.title: Instructions for the Requester of Form W-9 (03/2024)

passages.q: What did HANGS owe for the vendor that never gave a TIN?
passages.a: The backup withholding rate is 24% for reportable payments. ... If you don't collect backup withholding from affected payees as required, you may become liable for any uncollected amount.

passages.q: Is Tomas Arvelo, paid by the hour through accounts payable, a contractor for Form 1099-NEC or an employee for Form W-2?
passages.a: In determining whether the person providing service is an employee or an independent contractor, all information that provides evidence of the degree of control and independence must be considered. ... If you classify an employee as an independent contractor and you have no reasonable basis for doing so, then you may be held liable for employment taxes for that worker
